text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from a day out with
Nakayama
Festa, we hear the faint
sound of a cat meowing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's in the bushes... What do you want?
You
hungry or something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're so skinny... You must be a stray.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep your eyes on this cat for me.
I'll be
back in a minute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I wait, I call the city's animal
protection
services. Just as I'm hanging
up the phone,
Nakayama Festa comes
back with cat milk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here, drink this...
Oh, I guess us being
this close scares you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa puts down the plate
and takes a
step back. The cat begins to
timidly drink the
milk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Not really. I'm kinda used to taking care
of small
animals, though.
choice_data_list: You really know a lot about cats.
You really know a lot about cats.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she takes a step closer to look at its
wound,
the cat immediately runs off.
choice_data_list: Wait... is this little one hurt?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It really has its guard up. Something
awful must
have happened to it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a cut-throat world, the only one you
can really
trust is yourself. I get it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It might not even need our help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But its life could be in danger if its injury
gets
worse. I tell Nakayama Festa that
we have to do
something to help, even if
we're meddling.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, I dunno.
choice_data_list: Now is the time you need help!
Now is when you need help!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fine. Let's go after it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending about half a day
searching, we
finally find the cat in some
bushes in a park.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's surround it. You approach it from
this side.
I'll go around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The cat will probably come here where it
thinks
no one's around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Aaand bingo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Nakayama Festa predicts, the cat
comes
her way. I decide to leave the rest
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa kneels down hoping to
get her
line of sight as low as possible.
The cat stays put
and stares at her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Look at how far you've made it on your
own. I
bet you've never relied on anyone
else—not
once.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(You're like I used to be. You don't fit in
with the
group, and before you know it,
you're a loner.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(But not anymore. It's not so bad to lean
on
someone's shoulder every once in a
while.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As long as it's someone you can trust,
but that's
something you have to decide
for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stray cat stares at Nakayama Festa
for some
time, then, almost as if it
understood what she
said, slowly starts
walking toward her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Animal protection services should be
here soon.
We got the cat calm just in
time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You really hate minding your own
business.
choice_data_list: Now we can breathe a sigh of relief.
Now we can breathe a sigh of relief, can't we.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help myself. I didn't feel just
sorry for
the cat, it somehow made me
think of Nakayama
Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... What're you talking about?
choice_data_list: Because its noble air reminded me of you.
Because its noble air reminded me of you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... What're you talking about?
choice_data_list: Let's go check on the cat from time to time!
I hope this cat finds happiness...
I hope this cat finds happiness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sure, if I feel like it. It's gonna forget
who we are
though.
choice_data_list: Let's go check on the cat from time to time!
I hope this cat finds happiness...
I hope this cat finds happiness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Don't lick my hand. Lick the milk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You think so? What a cunning little
kitty.
choice_data_list: She says she wants to see you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cat pushes its head against
Nakayama Festa.
It seems like it wants
some pets. I let out a
chuckle, only for it
to glare back at me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Drink a lot of milk and sleep as much as
you can.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Look. It's dreaming. We've done
our job.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Quietly, so as not to wake the cat, we
walk away
together.
